summary: Plexus Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement. The agreement is a $500 million revolving credit facility (expandable to $750 million) maturing June 5, 2031, with interest rate options tied to Term SOFR, EURIBOR, or Daily Simple SONIA plus a margin based on leverage. It replaces the prior 2022 credit agreement, with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent. Customary covenants include minimum interest coverage of 3.00x and maximum leverage. This is a routine refinancing of existing credit facilities, not a special situation.
